value.name: records corrected filing sequence
value.description: Asha finishes marking the page so the corrected filing is understood as occurring after the caseworker was sworn.
evidence: With the three marks bound together on the page, the gap she had been measuring in her head stopped being a gap and became a sequence: the caseworker had been sworn before the corrected filing was stamped, not after.

value.name: sets pen down and pauses
value.description: Asha puts the pen aside and pauses with her hand on the desk, mentally preparing to speak the order aloud in Whitfield's office.
evidence: She set the pen down beside the pad and kept her hand on the desk for a moment, because naming the order to herself in the lamplight was not the same as the thing she would have to name in Whitfield's office, and she wanted to feel the difference before she stood up.

value.name: opens briefcase and organizes papers
value.description: Asha opens her briefcase and arranges the clerk's sheet, trial notes, and marked pad inside it in a deliberate order.
evidence: Asha lifted the briefcase onto the desk and thumbed the latches

She folded the clerk's sheet along its existing crease, set it inside against the spine of the trial notes, and laid the pad on top so the circled margin sat where her hand would find it first in the morning.

value.name: registers evidence assembled together
value.description: Asha feels the combined weight of the intake stamp, notes, and her own inked page as a single body of evidence.
evidence: For a moment she kept her palm flat on the leather, registering the weight of what was now together in one place: the intake stamp, the notes, the page where she had drawn the sequence in her own ink.

value.name: decides to carry papers to Whitfield
value.description: Asha closes the briefcase, committing herself to bring the documents to Whitfield's office tomorrow as physical proof rather than as something she can talk herself out of.
evidence: Then she closed the lid and clicked it shut, and the sound settled the question of whether she would carry this into Whitfield's office tomorrow as paper rather than as something she could still talk herself out of.

value.name: carries briefcase to the door
value.description: Asha lifts the briefcase and walks it to the door, preparing to leave with the assembled documents.
evidence: Asha lifted the briefcase off the desk and carried it to the door
